hero.title: About EduTrace
hero.subtitle: An offline-first application for managing student attendance, grades, and academic sessions. Parses Google Meet reports, tracks per-student progress, generates official grade documents, and works entirely in the browser — no server, no account required.

privacyFirst.title: Privacy First
privacyFirst.description: Keep your student data completely private. All information stays on your device, never uploaded to external servers.

simplifyWorkflow.title: Simplify Workflow
simplifyWorkflow.description: Automate the tedious process of parsing Google Meet attendance reports and calculating student statistics.

accessibleFree.title: Accessible & Free
accessibleFree.description: No account required, no subscription fees. Just open the app and start using it immediately.

offlineCapable.title: Offline Capable
offlineCapable.description: Work without internet connection. All data is stored locally in your browser using IndexedDB.

vue.name: Vue 3
vue.description: Progressive JavaScript framework — Composition API, reactivity, and SFC throughout

typescript.name: TypeScript
typescript.description: Strict mode with noUnusedLocals — every module, service, and component is fully typed

vite.name: Vite
vite.description: Sub-second HMR during development; optimised production builds with code splitting

tailwind.name: Tailwind CSS v4
tailwind.description: Utility-first styling with the Vite plugin — no PostCSS config, CSS-native variables

reka.name: Reka UI
reka.description: Unstyled, accessible headless component primitives — the foundation of every UI element

tanstack.name: TanStack Vue Table
tanstack.description: Headless table engine powering all data grids — sorting, filtering, column visibility

unovis.name: Unovis
unovis.description: Composable data-visualisation library used for attendance and grade charts

router.name: Vue Router
router.description: Official SPA router — lazy-loaded routes with breadcrumb metadata

i18n.name: Vue I18n
i18n.description: Full UI in English and Ukrainian — every label, error, and tooltip is translated

vueuse.name: VueUse
vueuse.description: Composition utility collection — virtual lists, storage, event hooks, and more

idb.name: IDB
idb.description: Promise-based IndexedDB wrapper — all data stored locally, versioned schema migrations

papaparse.name: PapaParse
papaparse.description: CSV parser running in a Web Worker — processes Google Meet attendance reports

comlink.name: Comlink
comlink.description: Transparent Web Worker RPC — offloads CSV parsing and grade aggregation off the main thread
